type Table = declared.TablePlan
  field Addresses []common.Address
  field Event abi.Event
  field Keys [][]string
  field Name string
  field Source string
  method Decode(l *model.Log) (map[string]string, error)
  method Definition() string
  method DefinitionChange(stored string) declared.DefinitionChange
  method Fields() []string
  method Key(fields []string) ([]string, bool)
  method Lookup(values map[string]string) (string, []string, error)
type Tables = declared.Plan
  field Tables []*declared.TablePlan
  method Addresses() []common.Address
  method Match(l *model.Log) []*declared.TablePlan
  method StartBlock() uint64
  method Table(name string) (*declared.TablePlan, bool)
  method Topics() []common.Hash
func TablesOf(s any) *sdk.Tables

package github.com/0xmhha/indexer-go/pkg/sdk/sdktest
const AllowComment untyped string
type Check struct
  field Chain *testchain.Chain
  field Declared bool
  field Features []string
  field Finality string
  field Prefixes []string
  field Requires []string
  field Settings map[string]any
type Finding struct
  field Pos token.Position
  field Reason string
  field Use string
  method String() string
func RequireDeterministic(t testing.TB, c sdktest.Check)
func RequireNoForbiddenUses(t testing.TB, dirs ...string)
func ScanSource(dir string) ([]sdktest.Finding, error)
